title: Elasticsearch
description: Documented public search engine (Elastic) for the Search Engine Constructor capability area.
body:
Elasticsearch is a documented search engine from Elastic. The distributed search and analytics engine behind countless site-search and log-search deployments.

How it works: It works by scoring each document with TF-IDF against the query terms and ranking by descending score.

Documented uses of this capability area include greenfield application generation, legacy system modernization, API platform design, and continuous testing pipelines.
